risks.risk: Reliance on external API webhooks & payment gateways
risks.mitigation: Implement webhooks idempotent handling, dead-letter queues, and sandbox test harnesses.

risks.risk: Real-time state synchronization under high concurrent load
risks.mitigation: Use Redis pub/sub for WebSocket connection scaling across worker instances.

risks.risk: User authentication, JWT token storage, and session security
risks.mitigation: Enforce HTTP-only secure cookies, short-lived JWTs with refresh token rotation.

risks.risk: Database schema migrations and relational query optimization
risks.mitigation: Use migration tools (e.g., Alembic/Prisma) with continuous backup automated scripts.
